advancedArguments.name: employeeNumber
advancedArguments.description: The employee's number as it is shown on screen, e.g. 000013. Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided. Leading zeros are optional. Note that some employees share a displayed number - the tool then asks which one rather than picking.

raw.description: The employee's number as it is shown on screen, e.g. 000013. Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided. Leading zeros are optional. Note that some employees share a displayed number - the tool then asks which one rather than picking.

advancedArguments.name: employeeName
advancedArguments.description: The employee's name (full or partial). Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided. If it matches more than one person the tool asks which one - never pick for the user.

raw.description: The employee's name (full or partial). Either employeeNumber or employeeName must be provided. If it matches more than one person the tool asks which one - never pick for the user.

advancedArguments.name: date
advancedArguments.description: Date to add the manual in and out for. Use the format returned by the dateFormat tool (MM/DD/YYYY for en-US, otherwise DD/MM/YYYY). Ask the user for this if not provided.

raw.description: Date to add the manual in and out for. Use the format returned by the dateFormat tool (MM/DD/YYYY for en-US, otherwise DD/MM/YYYY). Ask the user for this if not provided.

advancedArguments.name: dateSelectMode
advancedArguments.description: Search Criteria date selection mode, matching the page radio buttons: last7days (Last 7 Days), last30days (Last 30 Days), period (By Period, uses fromDate/toDate). Defaults to period with a wide range.

raw.description: Search Criteria date selection mode, matching the page radio buttons: last7days (Last 7 Days), last30days (Last 30 Days), period (By Period, uses fromDate/toDate). Defaults to period with a wide range.

advancedArguments.name: fromDate
advancedArguments.description: Search range start date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being submitted must fall inside the range.

raw.description: Search range start date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being submitted must fall inside the range.

advancedArguments.name: toDate
advancedArguments.description: Search range end date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being submitted must fall inside the range.

raw.description: Search range end date in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Only used when dateSelectMode is period. If omitted, a wide default range is used. The date being submitted must fall inside the range.

advancedArguments.name: isGroupByEmployee
advancedArguments.description: Optional Group By Employee checkbox on the Search Criteria panel. Defaults to false.

raw.description: Optional Group By Employee checkbox on the Search Criteria panel. Defaults to false.

advancedArguments.name: rosterGroup
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster group id used to load the roster list via GetRostersByGroupId. Defaults to 1.

raw.description: Optional roster group id used to load the roster list via GetRostersByGroupId. Defaults to 1.

advancedArguments.name: rosterCode
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster code for GetGridDataByCriteria, e.g. 000005 for 'Roster 1'. Takes precedence over rosterName. If neither is given the tool uses 000017 ('Default Yes'), which is the roster the admin screen pre-selects.

raw.description: Optional roster code for GetGridDataByCriteria, e.g. 000005 for 'Roster 1'. Takes precedence over rosterName. If neither is given the tool uses 000017 ('Default Yes'), which is the roster the admin screen pre-selects.

advancedArguments.name: rosterName
advancedArguments.description: Optional roster name, e.g. 'Roster 1'. Resolved to a roster code against the roster list. Ignored when rosterCode is given.

raw.description: Optional roster name, e.g. 'Roster 1'. Resolved to a roster code against the roster list. Ignored when rosterCode is given.

advancedArguments.name: inDate
advancedArguments.description: Optional In date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Defaults to the In date the grid already shows for that row. Only override this if the user explicitly wants a different In date.

raw.description: Optional In date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Defaults to the In date the grid already shows for that row. Only override this if the user explicitly wants a different In date.

advancedArguments.name: outDate
advancedArguments.description: Optional Out date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Defaults to the Out date the grid already shows, which is the NEXT day on a midnight/overnight shift. Only override this if the user explicitly wants a different Out date.

raw.description: Optional Out date, in the format returned by the dateFormat tool. Defaults to the Out date the grid already shows, which is the NEXT day on a midnight/overnight shift. Only override this if the user explicitly wants a different Out date.

advancedArguments.name: inTime
advancedArguments.description: In time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 08:30. Only required if no In time is already recorded on that date. Must fall inside the shift's grace window, which the tool reports as shiftPeriod/shiftToolTip.

raw.description: In time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 08:30. Only required if no In time is already recorded on that date. Must fall inside the shift's grace window, which the tool reports as shiftPeriod/shiftToolTip.

advancedArguments.name: outTime
advancedArguments.description: Out time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 17:30. Only required if no Out time is already recorded on that date. Must fall inside the shift's grace window, which the tool reports as shiftPeriod/shiftToolTip.

raw.description: Out time in HH:mm 24-hour format, e.g. 17:30. Only required if no Out time is already recorded on that date. Must fall inside the shift's grace window, which the tool reports as shiftPeriod/shiftToolTip.

advancedArguments.name: breakInTime
advancedArguments.description: Optional break in time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakOutTime must be given too.

raw.description: Optional break in time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakOutTime must be given too.

advancedArguments.name: breakOutTime
advancedArguments.description: Optional break out time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakInTime must be given too.

raw.description: Optional break out time in HH:mm 24-hour format. Break times are not mandatory - add them only if the user wants to. If given, breakInTime must be given too.

advancedArguments.name: reason
advancedArguments.description: Reason/comment explaining why the manual in and out is being added for this employee. Always required before submission. No reason is needed for the break times on their own.

raw.description: Reason/comment explaining why the manual in and out is being added for this employee. Always required before submission. No reason is needed for the break times on their own.

advancedArguments.name: confirmed
advancedArguments.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the data is correct. Set to false (or omit) to just preview/validate without submitting.

raw.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed the preview and explicitly confirmed the data is correct. Set to false (or omit) to just preview/validate without submitting.
